name: testland/jvm-unit-tests
description: Use whenever the task is to write, add, fix or review JVM unit tests in Java, Kotlin, Scala or Groovy: JUnit 5 by default, plus Kotest, Spock, ScalaTest and TestNG. Covers parameterized tests, lifecycle hooks, Mockito, AssertJ, JaCoCo coverage and Maven or Gradle CI.
